title: Office Christmas Party: Indo-Western Outfit Ideas (2026)
excerpt: Indo-western outfit ideas for an office Christmas party: kurtis with trousers, tunic tops with blazers and co-ord sets that go from desk to drinks.
body:
For an office Christmas party, the easiest Indo-western outfit is an embroidered kurti with tailored trousers or straight jeans, finished with a blazer and statement earrings. If the party is straight after work, choose one piece that works at your desk and add sparkle in the evening with jewellery, a lip colour and a change of shoes.

*By the Bahe Kurtiz styling team, Jaipur. Our kurtis, tunics and co-ords are stitched in our own Jaipur unit.*

**Quick answer**

- Smart casual party: embroidered kurti with tailored trousers and a blazer
- Drinks after work: short tunic top with dark jeans and heeled boots
- Lunch party: cotton co-ord set with a long cardigan
- Cocktail dress code: a midi dress with a light dupatta or stole
- Desk-to-party trick: swap flats for heels, add earrings, add a bold lip

## What does Indo-western mean for an office party?

Indo-western simply means mixing an Indian piece with a Western piece. A kurti with trousers, a tunic with jeans, or a co-ord set worn like a suit all count. It is a smart way to wear your culture at work without needing a full kurta set and dupatta, which can feel too formal for a pub or a team dinner.

It also solves a common problem: you want to look festive, but you do not want to change completely in the office bathroom at 5pm.

The [bottle green embroidered kurti with side tie-up](/products/green-embroidered-kurti/) is a good place to start. Green feels right for the season, the side tie adds shape, and it looks as smart with black trousers as it does with jeans.

## What should I wear for each dress code?

Office parties come with vague dress codes. Here is how to read them.

| Dress code | Indo-western outfit | Layer | Shoes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Smart casual | Embroidered kurti with tailored trousers | Black or camel blazer | Loafers or block heels |
| Casual drinks | Short tunic top with dark jeans | Leather or denim jacket | Ankle boots |
| Daytime lunch | Cotton co-ord set | Long cardigan | Ballet flats or juttis |
| Cocktail | Midi dress with a stole | Tailored coat | Heels |
| Festive or "Christmas jumpers" | Kurti over jeans with a fun knit on top | Knit cardigan | Trainers |

## How do I style a tunic top for a work party?

Short tunic tops are perfect for after-work drinks because they sit at the hip, which balances skinny or straight jeans well. The [wine brown embroidered cotton tunic top](/products/wine-brown-embroidered-cotton-tunic-top/) is a rich, wintry shade that looks festive without shouting. Wear it with dark jeans, gold hoops and ankle boots.

If you want a brighter look, a yellow or olive embroidered tunic adds cheer to a grey December day. Tuck one side lightly into high-waist trousers for a neater shape. Our guide on [how to style a short tunic top with jeans](/blog/how-to-style-a-short-tunic-top-with-jeans/) has more ideas.

Not sure whether to go printed or embroidered? Embroidery usually looks dressier at night, while block print feels more daytime. We compare both in [hand block print vs embroidered tunic tops](/blog/hand-block-print-vs-embroidered-tunic-tops/).

## Can I wear a co-ord set or dress instead?

Yes, and both are great for lunch parties. A co-ord set reads like a relaxed suit. The [floral printed cotton top and wide-leg palazzo co-ord](/products/women-s-cotton-floral-printed-top-wide-leg-palazzo-set-two-piece-co-ord-set/) looks pulled together with almost no effort. Add a long cardigan or a structured coat and you are ready for a team lunch.

For a cocktail-style party, a [white linen midi dress with shirt collar](/products/white-linen-collar-button-down-midi-dress/) can be dressed up with a sheer embroidered stole, gold jewellery and heels. It feels modern, and the stole adds the Indian touch.

You can see more relaxed options in our [cotton co-ord sets](/cotton-co-ord-sets-for-women/).

> **From our Jaipur studio:** Thread embroidery on cotton is soft against the skin and does not scratch like some sequins do, which matters if you are sitting at a desk all day. If you want shine for the evening, add it with jewellery rather than the fabric.

## How do I go from desk to party without changing?

Plan your outfit as two layers: a work layer and a party layer. Wear the kurti or tunic with trousers and flats during the day. At five, change into heels, swap your studs for statement earrings and add a bold lip. A small metallic clutch fits easily in your work bag.

- Keep a pair of heels or heeled boots under your desk
- Pack one statement pair of earrings
- Add a lipstick in berry, red or plum
- Carry a light stole that folds flat

In cold cities, a long tailored coat in black or camel ties the whole look together for the walk to the venue.

## What should I avoid at an office Christmas party?

Avoid anything too heavy or bridal, such as a full gota Anarkali, unless your office is hosting a desi-themed evening. Skip very long dupattas that trail, as they get caught on chairs and drinks. And steer clear of very sheer fabrics without a layer underneath. The goal is festive, comfortable and professional.

For more on celebrating at work, our post on [Diwali party outfits for the office](/blog/diwali-party-outfits-for-the-office-usa-uk/) covers dress codes in the USA and UK.

## Our pick for you

The bottle green kurti with trousers and a blazer is the most versatile choice. The wine brown tunic suits after-work drinks, and the floral co-ord is ideal for a daytime lunch. Ready sizes ship in 2–4 working days, and shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia is free and duties-paid.

A small etiquette note: dress for your workplace, not a wedding. When in doubt, ask a colleague what people wore last year.

## Frequently asked questions

**What is a good Indo-western outfit for an office party?**
An embroidered kurti with tailored trousers and a blazer is smart, festive and easy to wear. Add statement earrings for the evening.

**Can I wear a kurti with jeans to a work Christmas party?**
Yes, especially for casual drinks. Choose dark, well-fitting jeans and a dressier kurti or tunic, and add heeled boots.

**Is it okay to wear Indian clothes to a corporate event?**
Yes. Indo-western looks are widely worn at work events. Keep it polished and avoid anything too bridal or heavy.

**How do I wash an embroidered cotton kurti?**
Hand wash in cold water with a mild detergent, or use a gentle cycle inside a laundry bag. Dry it in the shade and iron it inside out.
